details:
Why would I want a simple programming system to allow building in game machines?

You and your friends can build machines in a world that allows this very simple script system build basic things like a catapult or even a car in the game in real time.

normally such systems in games you need a power stations add wires to button then add those wire to a contraption then you tell the device how it going to behave.

With Vrchat with all its new upgrades and the upcoming Unity 6 

I cant see why a very simple machine building system wouldn't work in VRchat

Yes but how would this help the game?

These simple building systems normally a fun time killer to test you and your friends on what you can build we currently don't have this, yes maybe a lone world creator could build this kind of asset but I feel it might be to limited without vrcchat dev support.

imagine going to a world and your friends says

lets build a machine a trap door a car, a mech robot that falls apart 

then post your experience online what you could build, with streamers and community who knows what we could build together. 

maybe even with the Persistence system we can save the machines. 

I hope such a system would be considered in VRchat in the future even though it could be difficult to add I think it will be far worth it in the long run

More details

What on what Wiremod Does

• Input/Output System: You can link a trigger (like a button, sensor, or keyboard pod controller) to a target (like a thruster, door, hydraulic, or screen) so that one element sends signals to control another.

• Logic & Arithmetic Gates: It provides digital and analog logic gates (AND, OR, NOT, add, multiply, etc.) so you can build complex automated circuits and decision-making systems.

• Sensors & Detection: Includes GPS units, gyroscopes, ranger distance finders, and cameras to scan the environment and feed data into your contraptions.

• Expression 2 (E2): It bundles a specialized in-game programming language called Expression 2 (or E2), which allows players to write custom code scripts to program CPUs, holographic displays, and automated machinery.
title: Dream idea, A simliar system like Wiremod from GarrysMod in Vrchat allows building simple machines and contraptions
